quality_rule: Known answers compare lowercased whitespace-normalized text after removing terminal punctuation; no tolerance changes. Official open-ended prompts recorded separately, not exact-match scored.

cases.prompt: What is 17 + 25? Reply with only the number.
What is 7 * 9? Reply with only the number.
What is the capital of France? Reply with only the city name.
What animal is beside the woman? Reply with only the animal name.
Is this scene on a beach or in a forest? Reply with only beach or forest.
Name the animal in each image, in image order. Reply with only the two animal names separated by a comma.
